Subject: Early access: manual welcome burst credits for Autonomo Labs

Hi team,

Autonomo Labs signed up via PLG yesterday and are in an early-access cohort. They hit our token limits during onboarding and requested a one-time boost to evaluate the streaming/latency behavior across a few longer prompt scenarios.

Quick context: Jared (engineering lead) is running a PoC of our streaming API + Dedicated shim and has committed to a pilot if the first round looks good. Their usage profile will spike for the next 48–72 hours while they run a synthetic load. They asked if we can manually issue a single-use promo that grants ~1,000 prompt/response tokens (roughly 1k generation tokens) to avoid friction.

Request: can ops generate a manual promo code (single-use, expires in 14 days) for 1,000 generation tokens and bind it to account autonomo@autonomo.ai? I’m asking for an expedited issuance and a short audit note so we can track impact.

Proposed governance: limit to one code per account ID, no stacking with other promos, and label it EARLY-ACCESS-AUTONOMO-1000. If finance needs approval we can route it, but I’m requesting a sales-approved exception given this is early access pilot conversion motion.

Marissa / Ben — can you please advise on quota guardrails and whether a manual issuance is OK under our current promo policy? Karthik tagging for any billing side concerns.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
